prompt: What was state of the schools regarding integration in the hometown of Miller Williams when he began his master's degree in Zoology?
answer: When Miller Williams began his master’s degree in zoology at the University of Arkansas—around 1951–52—schools in his hometown of Hoxie were still racially segregated. Hoxie did not begin integrating its public schools until 1955, after *Brown v. Board of Education*; it became one of Arkansas’s earliest districts to do so, amid intense local opposition and threats from segregationists.
